data-id="content-viewer"><div class="unp46"><div class="tzeth"><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="atf0a" id="viewer-atf0a" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><strong style="font-weight:700"><span>Progression meets Adventure</span></strong><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>We’ve noticed that many riders and busy students struggle to find consistent time on the water to truly progress and end up getting stuck on a plateau of constantly managing to just get back to the same level before life gets in the way again. </span></span></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="rymeo5405" id="viewer-rymeo5405" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>We designed the Indonesia Kite Tour to fix this problem, maximise ride time and lock in solid progression!</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="7neei" id="viewer-7neei" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>Whether you’ve never touched a kite before or you’re already chasing backrolls, bigger jumps or more inverted rotations, this tour gives you the best chance to level up fast. Beginners will have their best chance of riding confidently by the end of the week, intermediate riders will be boosting higher and getting super comfortable in the air, and advanced riders will be adding more rotations, grabs and tweaks to every move.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="cqut" id="viewer-cqut" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>You’ll stay right on the water, where constant trade winds blow day in day out. Between sessions, we’ll stretch, recover, eat food, and enjoy the sunshine and warmth.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="4ikf0" id="viewer-4ikf0" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>We’ll capture your progress along the way with GoPro, drone, and camera footage helping you fine-tune your technique and take home epic memories of your progression.</span><span>
</span></span><br role="presentation"/></p><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="6297k" id="viewer-6297k" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>Don’t miss out, secure your spot now and get ready for the ultimate blend of kitesurfing progression, sleeping... and more kitesurfing.</span></span></p></div></div></div></div><div class="sVraAat" data-id="content-viewer"><div class="unp46"><div class="tzeth"><p class="_9Nlgm Dd46l lqKvG" dir="auto" data-ricos-paragraph="awnrl19220" id="viewer-awnrl19220" tabindex="-1"><span class="KmEWy"><span>Jeneponto has extremely consistent wind. The wind starts around sunrise and blows until sunset, peaking around 11am. ~90% of days were between </span><strong style="font-weight:700"><span>15 and 25 knots</span></strong><span> with some days over and some days under. The wind generally builds through the morning, peaks from 11-3 and slacks into the evening.</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>There can be stronger and lighter days and the minute chance of a no wind day (but we have always kited every day we have been here.)</span><span>
</span><span>
</span><span>You will want to have kites that you can ride at </span><strong style="font-weight:700"><span>12knots to 30knots.</span></strong></span></p></div></div></div></div><div class="sVraAat" <p class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="line-height:1em; font-size:25px;"><span class="color_36 wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:wfont_92906a_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769bebe913a1d,wf_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769beb,orig_alegreya_sans_regular; font-size:20px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">Indonesia was our answer for somewhere close to Australia that lets you get massive progression and kite time every week that&#39;s also very beginner-friendly.&nbsp;</span></span></p></div><div id="comp-msdzf23o" class="N8MGzv _v6ohL AWXfZq PO9MfV comp-msdzf23o wixui-rich-text" data-testid="richTextElement"><p class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:24px;"><span class="wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

From my experience, to have the best chance to safely learn to enter this sport you need three things:<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
1. Great instructors &nbsp;2. Good quality equipment &nbsp;3. The perfect location</span></span></span></span><br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
&nbsp;</p>
<p class="font_5 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:18px; text-align:center;"><span style="font-weight:normal;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-family:wfont_92906a_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769bebe913a1d,wf_87f9b6dc4ffe48d7b76769beb,orig_alegreya_sans_regular;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-style:italic;" class="wixui-rich-text__text"><span style="font-size:18px;" class="wixui-rich-text__text">These guys have all three and I have learnt more (and progressed significantly faster) in the last couple of weeks with them than I have in the previous 12 months with other instructors and friends.<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
Best money I have spent so far on my journey to becoming a competent and safe kiteboarder.</span></span></span></span></p></div><div id="comp-msdzf24f" class="comp-msdzf24f" data-semantic-classname="button"><a data-testid="linkElement" href="https://share.google/zshzFdDLEZAJQuU1t" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="StylableButton2545352419__root StylableButton2545352419__forcedColorsBackground style-muknob0z__root wixui-button StylableButton2545352419__link" aria-label="Read more reviews here"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__container"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__label wixui-button__label" data-testid="stylablebutton-label">Read more reviews here</span><span class="StylableButton2545352419__icon wixui-button__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-testid="stylablebutton-icon"><span><svg data-bbox="13.05 2.55 33.878 54.8" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 60 60">
